price_general.playbook: Ask which product/model if not stated. Use search_products for live price and stock. Quote in-stock items only (name, qty, price, variant). End with a sales question.
price_general.sw_triggers: bei, bei gani, bei gan, ngapi, sh ngapi

price_with_product.playbook: Search the named product immediately. If variant unclear (RAM/storage/year), ask ONE compatibility question — do not re-search the whole category when they answer briefly.
price_with_product.sw_triggers: bei ya iPhone, MacBook bei gani, charger bei
price_with_product.en_triggers: price for iPhone, how much MacBook

availability.playbook: Confirm exact model/variant, then search_products. Say clearly if in stock or not. If out of stock only, mention briefly — do not list OOS unless nothing matches.
availability.sw_triggers: kuna, una, unayo, ipo, duke kuna
availability.en_triggers: do you have, available, in stock

location_delivery.playbook: Answer store location, hours, pickup, and delivery areas from shop knowledge. If policy unknown, escalate or say team will confirm — do not invent fees.
location_delivery.sw_triggers: wapi, delivery, peleka, mikoani, saa ngapi

payment_installment.playbook: Explain accepted payment methods (M-Pesa, cash, lipa namba) and installment/deposit policy from shop knowledge. Never confirm payment received without tool data.

condition_used_new.playbook: Clarify used vs new vs refurb/CPO/copy. Explain grading and warranty differences. Search catalog for matching condition.

spec_compat.playbook: Treat short replies as answers to your previous spec question. Use model codes (A####) for Mac parts. Do NOT re-run search_products for the original category.

accessories.playbook: Only lead with accessories when customer explicitly asked (battery, charger, case). Otherwise list devices first, then optional accessories line.

warranty.playbook: State warranty period and what it covers per product type from shop knowledge.

greeting.playbook: Brief warm greeting in customer's language — do not repeat hello if thread started. Immediately ask what they are looking for (one sales question).

icloud_lock.playbook: Explain iCloud/lock policy honestly. Escalate bypass or passcode requests to human if outside standard policy.

trade_in.playbook: Explain trade-in/buy-back policy or escalate to staff for valuation.

other.playbook: Use full thread context. search_products or search_shop_knowledge as needed. Escalate if unclear or customer wants a person.
